scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Hey, I'm UrFavXBF, and this is Video AI Editor, my Remotion toolkit with thirty-three real effects.
scenes.title: VIDEO AI EDITOR
scenes.subtitle: 33 real effects. 1 cut list.
scenes.caption: Hey, I'm UrFavXBF, and this is Video AI Editor, my Remotion toolkit with 33 real effects.

scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: And I'm PIX! Every effect in this reel is actually rendered by the repo.
scenes.title: VIDEO AI EDITOR
scenes.subtitle: Rendered by the repo itself

scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Step one. Run npm c i, then npm run advanced f x sample to build the sample take.
scenes.title: STEP 1  SET UP
scenes.caption: Step one: run npm ci, then npm run advanced-fx:sample to build the sample take.

scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Step two! Preview any effect with F x Preview. Just pass its I D.
scenes.title: STEP 2  PREVIEW ONE EFFECT
scenes.caption: Step two! Preview any effect with FxPreview. Just pass its ID.

scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Step three. Add a segment to edit dot json, kind f x, then render the edit.
scenes.title: STEP 3  CUT IT INTO YOUR EDIT
scenes.caption: Step three: add a segment to edit.json, kind "fx", then render the edit.

scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Okay, roll the reel! Thirty three effects, let's go!
scenes.title: ROLL THE REEL

scenes.name: Orbit
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Orbit. Tiles swing around me, in front and behind.

scenes.name: Chat Takeover
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Chat Takeover! Message bubbles flood the frame.

scenes.name: Frame Escape
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Frame Escape. The subject steps right out of the frame.

scenes.name: Snap Zoom
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Snap Zoom! A whip, a hit, and we punch in close.

scenes.name: Checklist Pop
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Checklist Pop. Items bubble in, one by one.

scenes.name: Headline Storm
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Headline Storm! Big headlines slam in.

scenes.name: Zoom Portal
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Zoom Portal. We dive straight through a portal.

scenes.name: Growth Curve
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Growth Curve! A chart draws itself upward.

scenes.name: B-roll Overlay
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: B-roll Overlay. A second layer slides over the take.

scenes.name: Paper Cutout
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Paper Cutout! A sticker border, baked frame by frame.

scenes.name: Magazine Cover
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Magazine Cover. The shot becomes a cover story.

scenes.name: Liquid Glass
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Liquid Glass! A glassy lens glides across the shot.

scenes.name: Zoom Through Cut
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Zoom Through Cut. A blurred zoom carries the cut.

scenes.name: Green Screen
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Green Screen! The background swaps, the subject stays.

scenes.name: Frame Break
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Frame Break. The frame cracks, then shatters.

scenes.name: Digital Zoom
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Digital Zoom! Click, click, click, punching in.

scenes.name: Phone Mockup
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Phone Mockup. The take plays inside a phone.

scenes.name: Checklist Tally
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Checklist Tally! Glass cards count up the wins.

scenes.name: Glass Widgets
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Glass Widgets. Frosted widgets float beside the subject.

scenes.name: Checklist
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Checklist! Tick, tick, tick, done.

scenes.name: Split
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Split. The screen splits for a side by side point.

scenes.name: RGB Split
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: RGB Split! Color channels tear apart around the subject.

scenes.name: Speed Trails
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Speed Trails. Eight glowing trails chase the subject.

scenes.name: Film Light Leak
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Film Light Leak! A warm flare sweeps across.

scenes.name: Glass Shatter
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Glass Shatter. Twenty four fragments blast outward.

scenes.name: Liquid Displacement
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Liquid Displacement! The whole video warps like water.

scenes.name: Pixel Dissolve
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Pixel Dissolve. The subject breaks into pixels.

scenes.name: Whip Pan Blur
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Whip Pan Blur! Two shots swap with motion blur.

scenes.name: SVG Path Morph
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: SVG Path Morph. Lines draw and morph around the subject.

scenes.name: Comic Halftone
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Comic Halftone! Print dots and a pop art subject.

scenes.name: Shader Portal
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Shader Portal. A swirling window opens to a second shot.

scenes.name: Film Burn Reveal
scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Film Burn Reveal! A hot burn eats into the next scene.

scenes.name: Audio Reactive Particles
scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: Audio Reactive Particles. Ninety particles follow the real audio.

scenes.speaker: host
scenes.text: That's all thirty-three. Pick the ones that serve your story, not all of them at once.
scenes.title: THAT'S 33
scenes.subtitle: Use FX for storytelling, not decoration
scenes.caption: That's all 33. Pick the ones that serve your story, not all of them at once.

scenes.speaker: pix
scenes.text: Clone the repo, run the sample, and make something original. Bye bye!
